children: On November 27, 2026, Nasdaq notified the company that it failed to meet Listing Rule 5550(b)(1), which requires at least $2.5 million in stockholders' equity; the company reported equity of $755,911. The deficiency is an additional basis for possible delisting, and the Nasdaq Hearings Panel is scheduled to consider the company's continued listing on January 7, 2027; trading will continue pending its decision.
